items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: Chuck Cornish. That's his name. He wrote both sides of this thing.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Chuck Cornish. That's his name. Chuck Cornish. That's his name. He wrote both sides of this thing. Uh-huh. Because he recorded two. He sang and he made a few things for, he did something for Rick Records. I can't remember what it was. But anyway, he wrote those two too. You know, back then I did a lot of writing, but whenever a song come up that, you know, they would go to the company and say, well, here's a song I wrote for Tommy Rich, here's a song, you know. But Eddie…
Did Boe have last decision on what tunes were recorded?
